title: flowlive/1: one event of the live Flow scheduler
description: What mzlab_core::flow::sched writes through events_since: one event for every change of state of a job (kind job), of an instance (kind node, the card) and of a plan that cannot be scheduled (kind plan). Code: crates/mzlab-core/src/flow/sched_events.rs.

seq.description: Grows by one with every event of a scheduler.

rev.description: Number of updates of the plan so far; an event of an older revision is dropped by the page.

instance.description: Instance id of the plan; empty for kind plan.

item.description: Name of the plan input that drives the job (never an index); null for a step that is not per_item and for kind node.

frac.description: Share done (a card: the mean over its jobs); null = not known.

parte.description: kind node: jobs done or reused.

ms.description: kind job: time of the finished job as the executor reported it, null until done; kind node: the sum over its done jobs.

key.description: kind job: plan_key of the job (SHA-256).

blocked_by.description: State blocked: what it waits for (permission.memory, platform.computer, plan.problem).
